data: NVIDIA's operating income rose from $4,224 million in fiscal 2023 (year ended January 29, 2023) to $81,453 million in fiscal 2025 (year ended January 26, 2025). That is an increase of $77,229 million, or roughly 1,828%, meaning fiscal 2025 operating income was about 19.3 times the fiscal 2023 level. The fiscal 2023 figure was held down in part by a $1,353 million acquisition termination cost, while fiscal 2025 benefited from revenue growing from $26,974 million to $130,497 million.
